evidence.detail: Add Match form uses standard HTML form with method='post' and button type='submit' — full page reload on every action
post_matches() handler handles add/change/delete via form POST and returns redirect(), confirming no inline API path exists
Matches display is already API-driven via livematchtable partial, but the Add/Change/Delete form actions are not

triage.notes: Scope is clearly > 150 lines: needs new API endpoints (POST/PATCH/DELETE for matches), JavaScript event handlers to submit asynchronously and update the table, and template rework. The livematchtable infrastructure already exists as a model.
